text_block_list.text:
That was a good experience. I was able
to throw
myself into training much more
than usual.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
The Kobe Shimbun Hai, and after that,
the
Kikuka Sho...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Slowly, but surely, my time in the
winner's circle
approaches.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
